mapper.sql: select r.rbs_id as resume_id, r.rbs_user_id as user_id, r.rbs_resume_name as resume_name, r.rbs_job_direction as job_direction, r.rbs_is_default as is_default, r.rbs_status as status, r.rbs_updated_at as updated_at, r.rbs_file_path, r.rbs_file_name, r.rbs_file_size, (select count(*) from t_res_education e where e.edu_resume_id = r.rbs_id) as education_count, (select count(*) from t_res_work w where w.wrk_resume_id = r.rbs_id) as work_count, (select count(*) from t_res_project p where p.prj_resume_id = r.rbs_id) as project_count, (select count(*) from t_res_skill s where s.skl_resume_id = r.rbs_id) as skill_count, least(100, case when nullif(trim(r.rbs_resume_name), '') is null then 0 else 15 end + case when nullif(trim(r.rbs_job_direction), '') is null then 0 else 20 end + case when exists(select 1 from t_res_education e where e.edu_resume_id = r.rbs_id) then 20 else 0 end + case when exists(select 1 from t_res_work w where w.wrk_resume_id = r.rbs_id) then 25 else 0 end + case when exists(select 1 from t_res_project p where p.prj_resume_id = r.rbs_id) then 10 else 0 end + case when exists(select 1 from t_res_skill s where s.skl_resume_id = r.rbs_id) then 10 else 0 end ) as completeness from t_res_base r
mapper.select: where r.rbs_user_id = #{userId} and r.rbs_status = 1 order by r.rbs_is_default desc, r.rbs_updated_at desc, r.rbs_id desc
where r.rbs_id = #{resumeId} and r.rbs_user_id = #{userId} and r.rbs_status = 1
where r.rbs_id = #{resumeId} and r.rbs_user_id = #{userId} and r.rbs_status = 1 for update

select edu_id as educationId, edu_school as school, edu_major as major, edu_degree as degree, edu_start_date as startDate, edu_end_date as endDate, edu_gpa as gpa, edu_description as description from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by edu_start_date desc, edu_id desc

select wrk_id as workId, wrk_company as company, wrk_position as position, wrk_department as department, wrk_start_date as startDate, wrk_end_date as endDate, wrk_is_current as current, wrk_salary_range as salaryRange, wrk_description as description from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by wrk_is_current desc, wrk_start_date desc, wrk_id desc

select prj_id as projectId, prj_name as name, prj_role as role, prj_start_date as startDate, prj_end_date as endDate, prj_description as description, prj_tech_stack as techStack from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by prj_start_date desc, prj_id desc
select skl_id as skillId, skl_name as name, skl_level as level from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by skl_level desc, skl_id
select count(*) from t_res_base where rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1
select (select count(*) from t_app_record where app_resume_id = #{resumeId}) + (select count(*) from t_tal where tal_resume_id = #{resumeId})
select rbs_id from t_res_base where rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1 order by rbs_updated_at desc, rbs_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_res_base (rbs_user_id, rbs_resume_name, rbs_job_direction, rbs_is_default, rbs_status, rbs_file_path, rbs_file_name, rbs_file_size) values (#{userId}, #{resumeName}, #{jobDirection}, #{isDefault}, 1, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: update t_res_base set rbs_resume_name = #{resumeName}, rbs_job_direction = #{jobDirection}, rbs_is_default = #{isDefault}, rbs_updated_at = now(), rbs_file_path = #{filePath}, rbs_file_name = #{fileName}, rbs_file_size = #{fileSize} where rbs_id = #{resumeId} and rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1
update t_res_base set rbs_is_default = 0 where rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1

update t_res_base set rbs_status = 0, rbs_is_default = 0, rbs_file_path = null, rbs_file_name = null, rbs_file_size = null, rbs_updated_at = now() where rbs_id = #{resumeId} and rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1
update t_res_base set rbs_is_default = 1 where rbs_id = #{resumeId} and rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_res_education (edu_resume_id, edu_school, edu_major, edu_degree, edu_start_date, edu_end_date, edu_gpa, edu_description) values (#{resumeId}, #{item.school}, #{item.major}, #{item.degree}, #{item.startDate}, #{item.endDate}, #{item.gpa}, #{item.description})

insert into t_res_work (wrk_resume_id, wrk_company, wrk_position, wrk_department, wrk_start_date, wrk_end_date, wrk_is_current, wrk_salary_range, wrk_description) values (#{resumeId}, #{item.company}, #{item.position}, #{item.department}, #{item.startDate}, #{item.endDate}, #{item.current}, #{item.salaryRange}, #{item.description})

insert into t_res_project (prj_resume_id, prj_name, prj_role, prj_start_date, prj_end_date, prj_description, prj_tech_stack) values (#{resumeId}, #{item.name}, #{item.role}, #{item.startDate}, #{item.endDate}, #{item.description}, #{item.techStack})
insert into t_res_skill (skl_resume_id, skl_name, skl_level) values (#{resumeId}, #{item.name}, #{item.level})
